_about: Types of the military frame for Actium (43 §4, curator 2026-11-15): category, our label and description, and the Wikidata item checked at Wikidata on 2026-11-15 (null: none exists; a local Type). Wikidata is a voice (D-145): what a Type was, and when, comes from sources as dated claims. Seeded by slices/seed_types.py.

types.label: trireme
types.description: Oared warship with three files of rowers on each side.

types.label: quadrireme
types.description: Oared warship rowed by files of four oarsmen (a 'four').

types.label: quinquereme
types.description: Oared warship rowed by files of five oarsmen (a 'five'), the main line warship of the Republic's fleets.

types.label: hexareme
types.description: Oared warship rowed by files of six oarsmen (a 'six').

types.label: large polyreme
types.description: The larger Hellenistic oared warships, from the 'seven' upward; how they were rowed is a modern reconstruction.

types.label: 'ten' (deceres)
types.description: The largest oared warships named at Actium, rowed by files of ten oarsmen; a modern reconstruction of an ancient name.

types.label: Liburnian (liburna)
types.description: Small, fast galley of Illyrian origin, used by Octavian's fleet.

types.label: legion
types.description: The Roman heavy infantry unit; by 31 BC organised in ten cohorts.

types.label: cohort
types.description: A tenth of a legion, of three maniples (six centuries), the legion's tactical unit by the late Republic; also a free-standing unit (a praetorian cohort).

types.label: campaign fleet
types.description: A fleet raised for a campaign under a commander; the Republic had no standing fleets.

types.label: fleet wing
types.description: A division of a fleet's battle line (left, centre, right) under its own commander.

types.label: fleet prefect (praefectus classis)
types.description: Commander of a fleet or squadron; Wikidata describes the imperial office, so a Republican holder needs its own dated claim.

types.label: fleet soldier or sailor (classiarius)
types.description: A man serving in a fleet: rower, sailor, or soldier aboard.

types.label: naval ram
types.description: The bronze-sheathed beak at a warship's bow, below the waterline.

types.label: fighting tower
types.description: A tower raised on a warship's deck for missile troops.

types.label: fire missile
types.description: Burning missiles or pots of fire thrown at enemy ships.
